notes.title: Pestersim Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685091/8865e3d2078febe90718af1054d45b175c488f87.png[/img]

Great news, friends! Homestuck titles Hiveswap Friendsim and Pesterquest are now available in Pestersim, one convenient bundle at a bargain price for all your friending needs.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/35459/Pestersim/

In Hiveswap Friendsim, you have crash-landed on Alternia and must survive and even thrive on its harsh surface. Fans will find themselves searching for friendship as they play through all 18 volumes in this visual novel adventure set in the Homestuck universe.

Pesterquest puts players on a quest of epic importance where they must find answers and discover or reconnect with friends as they zap between Earth and Alternia. Fans will enjoy all 14 volumes in this grimsical episodic visual novel set in the darkly funny Homestuck/Hiveswap universe.

notes.title: Pesterquest 80% off in the Fellow Traveller Publisher Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685091/9ab5d43e332bb0dfb4f87770cab519aaca254348.png[/img]

[h3]The annual Fellow Traveller [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]Publisher Sale[/url] is now on - and to celebrate, Pesterquest is 80% off! [/h3]

There are plenty more Fellow Traveller titles on sale to choose from - so whether you're looking for something new, a bargain, some cool soundtracks and bundles, or even something to play on Steam Deck, we're sure to have something just for you.

[h3]We're also thrilled to announce that three new games are joining the Fellow Traveller family; [b]Scrabdackle[/b], [b]Wander Stars[/b] and [b]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/b] - read up on each of them below![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32967820/40c1797b8a73e5d9ffe2140b51ffa845f73fec0e.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1575810/Wander_Stars/]Wander Stars[/url]:[/b] Follow the story of Ringo and Wolfe as they join forces to collect the pieces of the Wanderstar Map in this turn-based RPG with roguelite elements! Use words to create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in an adventure inspired by 90s anime.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1578720/Scrabdackle/]Scrabdackle[/url]:[/b] As a novice wizard, discover the intricate world of Scrabdackle and experience the impact wizardkind has unknowingly had upon it. Scrabdackle is a hand-drawn, non-linear adventure with a vast, intricate overworld, tight and responsive combat, cheeky banter, and pages of lore to discover.
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2246470/Kulebra_and_the_Souls_of_Limbo/]Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo[/url]:[/b] A 3D adventure where you play as Kulebra, a dead snake with a heart of gold that wakes up in Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.[/list]So get exploring and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/fellowtraveller/sale/fellowtraveller2023]grab some great narrative games[/url]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144030/Pesterquest/

Timelines collide in the next chapter of the Friendsim story! After befriending the weird and wild trolls of Hiveswap Friendsim, it’s time to meet some kids a little closer to home. Zap to Earth to meet new friends in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144030/Pesterquest/]Pesterquest,[/url] the next visual novel in the Homestuck universe.

Your favorite artists, writers and musicians return from Hiveswap Friendsim, with new talent joining their ranks as the 14-volume tale unfolds. Start making friends and messing up canon on September 4th with the first two volumes by Andrew Hussie and Aysha U. Farah.

This time around, you can make every friend in one affordable bundle. That’s 20 incredible characters and 14 total volumes for just $12!

If you’re excited for this universe-crossing friend ‘em up, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144030/Pesterquest/]wishlist us on Steam.[/url] Happy pestering!
